name: convention-options-of-a-required-call
description: A top-level declaration that binds the result of require with the row's module binds as an import of that module does: a destructured exported name under a local name is the row's function, and a plain binding is a namespace through which the function is called. The options of both calls are read, so the root file of each directory they name is a root and the one in the default directory is reported as a file nothing imports. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named remix for the package @remix-run/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory option of a vitePlugin call in vite.config.cjs moves.
